baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative ja'ala, the Ka'bah as the sacred House, the sacred month, and qiyaman li-l-nas.
baseline_models.mechanism: God appoints a fixed refuge, a protected spatial field, and a recurrent protected time to function together as the mainstay of public life. Qiyaman therefore names maintained social order and livelihood, not only the honor of a monument.

activation_trace.role: Causative placement supplies deliberate appointment and assigns the listed institutions their public function.
The elevated square-house image supplies a fixed and conspicuous center for the system.
Shelter and dwelling make the center a refuge that gathers and houses rather than a bare landmark.
Spatial sanctuary and its attached rights create a protected field around the House.
Temporal truce extends the same protection into a recurrent sacred interval.
Mainstay, order, and livelihood give qiyaman its functional force as what keeps collective life standing.

changed_reading.before: The Ka'bah and sacred month are honored observances that benefit people.
changed_reading.after: God's appointment coordinates refuge, protected space, and recurrent truce as infrastructure by which collective life, livelihood, and order remain standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sanctuary-bound offering, the garlands, qiyaman, and the purpose clause about learning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Offerings move toward the sanctuary while neck-marks make their destination and protected status publicly readable. Protection therefore travels with marked carriers, routing resources and obligations through space while restraining seizure; this mobile legibility contributes to public support.

activation_trace.role: A gift sent to the sanctuary supplies directed movement of material provision toward the protected center.
A neck-marker used for distinction makes the carrier's protected destination visible in transit.
A distinguishing sign that guides an observer links visible marking to the ayah's movement from institution to knowledge.
Care, preservation, and governance make protected circulation an actively maintained public arrangement.

changed_reading.before: The offerings and garlands are additional sacred objects in the list.
changed_reading.after: They are mobile, visibly marked carriers of sanctuary-bound obligation: protection travels with them, making circulation itself part of the public support system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from God's appointment to 'so that you may know,' followed by God's knowledge of the heavens, earth, and every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah moves from a bounded and publicly readable order to unbounded divine knowledge. The institution is thus an embodied lesson: humans infer from coordinated signs within their field to the knowledge that comprehends the whole field.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit human-learning and divine-knowing axis.
The mark that distinguishes and guides lets the appointed order operate as evidence rather than as an unrelated doctrinal preface.
What is above and overarching supplies the upper reach of the total field known by God.
The lower field opposite the sky completes the vertical span of the claim.
Comprehensiveness and completion prevent the knowledge claim from being restricted to the sacred system alone.
Anything knowable or reportable supplies the unrestricted object of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The institutions are followed by a doctrinal assertion that God knows everything.
changed_reading.after: The appointed institution is itself an embodied lesson: a bounded order humans can read becomes evidence pointing from local coordination to God's exhaustive knowledge of the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence exposes appetites that dissolve attention and social bonds, then makes reachable game a revealing test. An intentional breach is not left as raw exclusion: judgment converts it into equivalent compensation, including an offering that reaches the Ka'bah. The focus's qiyaman is thereby revised into a resilient boundary-and-repair system.

activation_trace.role: A drink that covers the intellect supplies a counter-mechanism that disables the discernment and restraint public order needs.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns nearby prey into a disclosure of otherwise hidden restraint.
The second mapped inventory likewise supplies trial as a means by which the actor's state becomes manifest.
Deliberate intention differentiates accountable breach from mere contact with the boundary.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the conversion from violation into reparative obligation.
Equivalence and balancing make compensation proportionate rather than arbitrary.
The sanctuary-bound offering routes the repaired obligation into the same material channel named in the focus ayah.
The fixed sacred House is the destination that closes the reparative route.

structural_cues: 5:87-93 calibrates permission, self-restraint, oath repair, and practices that generate enmity rather than support.
5:94 makes reachable game a test whose result is concealed fear or transgression.
5:95 routes intentional breach through judged equivalence, offering, food, or fasting, while 5:96 redraws the land and sea boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appetite, revealed testing, intentional breach, equivalent compensation, and an offering reaching the Ka'bah. I infer that qiyaman names a resilient boundary-and-repair system, not only a protected monument; the live alternative is that these rules merely exemplify obedience without defining the focus ayah's public-support mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sacred complex supports people chiefly by forbidding violence and protecting a center.
changed_reading.after: It supports people by calibrating access, testing restraint, and converting intentional breach into proportionate, sanctuary-routed repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, divine knowledge covers both disclosure and concealment, while human judgment is told not to equate bad with good when numerical abundance attracts. The purpose 'so that you may know' is sharpened into trained discrimination: public signs sustain only when their quality is read correctly rather than counted or admired.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure continues the focus ayah's explicit knowing axis into what people reveal and conceal.
Hiding and covering supplies the unseen side that human public markers cannot exhaust.
Comparison and equivalence are explicitly refused, making discernment a judgment of kind rather than a neutral tally.
Badness opposed to the good supplies the qualitative distinction that the knower must preserve.
Growth in number supplies the attractive but epistemically insufficient signal.

structural_cues: 5:98 commands knowledge of paired severity and forgiveness.
5:99 contrasts the messenger's delivery with God's knowledge of what is disclosed and concealed.
5:100 denies equivalence between bad and good even when the bad's abundance attracts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden versus disclosed conduct and quality versus quantity. I infer that the focus institution trains calibrated discernment by making consequential distinctions public; the live alternative is that 5:100 is only a general moral maxim with no institutional feedback into qiyaman.

changed_reading.before: Learning from the sacred complex means recognizing that God knows all things.
changed_reading.after: Learning from it also means acquiring a public discipline of distinction that resists concealment, false equivalence, and the glamour of abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact divine-appointment construction returns under negation for named animal taboos, which are attributed instead to falsehood and inherited nonknowledge. This makes authorization constitutive: a visible restriction or marked animal does not become socially sustaining merely by resembling the focus ayah's sacred forms.

activation_trace.role: Causative appointment reappears under explicit negation, creating a direct foil to God's positive appointment in the focus ayah.
Contradiction of truth supplies the mechanism by which customary sacrality is falsely attributed to God.
Absent knowledge exposes inherited sufficiency as an unreliable basis for sacred classification.
Failure to find and follow the right way contrasts fabricated custom with the focus ayah's directed sanctuary order.

structural_cues: 5:101-102 warns that demands for additional disclosed rules can become burdens and then grounds for rejection.
5:103 uses 'God did not appoint' to negate four customary animal designations.
5:104 contrasts inherited sufficiency with ancestors who possessed neither knowledge nor guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal negative foil to ja'ala Allah and links the rejected designations to falsehood, ignorance, and failed guidance. I infer that divine authorization is part of what lets the focus system be qiyaman; the live alternative is a narrower rejection of four customs without a general authorization criterion.

changed_reading.before: Sacred status appears to reside in marked objects and restrictions themselves.
changed_reading.after: The sanctuary, month, offerings, and garlands sustain because God appoints and directs them; analogous markings and restrictions fabricated through custom are counter-institutions, not qiyam.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testimony sequence gives limited human knowledge a public procedure: witnessed claims can be tested, displaced witnesses can be replaced, and oaths can be returned. The following gathering of messengers ends in confessed human nonknowledge before the knower of the unseen. The focus's local signs therefore model accountable knowledge under, but never equal to, divine omniscience.

activation_trace.role: A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the human evidentiary unit that must be made public and reviewable.
Standing in another's place supplies procedural substitution when the first testimony fails.
Returning a claim to its prior side supplies reversible review rather than irreversible assertion.
The contrast between denied creaturely knowledge and intensified divine knowing fixes the asymmetry of the epistemic system.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain that public witnessing cannot independently master.

structural_cues: 5:106 establishes paired witnesses, oath, suspicion, and the prohibition on concealing testimony.
5:107-108 responds to discovered fault with replacement witnesses and the prospect of returned oaths.
5:109 gathers the messengers, who disclaim knowledge before God's knowledge of hidden realities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revisable testimony, role substitution, returned oaths, creaturely nonknowledge, and divine knowledge of the unseen. I infer a two-tier epistemology in which qiyaman includes procedures for acting responsibly under partial knowledge; the live alternative is that the legal procedure and the focus's cosmic knowledge claim remain parallel but unintegrated.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts ordinary human learning with God's unlimited knowledge.
changed_reading.after: It also implies an institutional answer to that asymmetry: humans keep society standing through visible, revisable evidence while total hidden knowledge remains God's alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table sequence joins descent from the sky, food, settled hearts, knowledge, witness, recurrent feast, visible sign, and apportioned provision. It activates the focus list as a distributed public table: House, month, offering, and marker coordinate recurring provision so that material participation becomes reassurance and knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A food-bearing table supplies the concrete provisioning surface around which the later sequence gathers.
The overarching sky supplies the source domain that links material provision back to the focus's heaven-and-earth knowledge span.
Settling and reassurance make eating functional evidence for the participants rather than consumption alone.
Knowledge arising in the sequence directly activates the focus purpose clause.
A feast defined by recurrence supplies the periodic social form that resonates with the sacred month.
The alternate mapped image of counted returning time strengthens the link between recurrence and calendrical support.
A manifest sign turns the provision into publicly apprehensible evidence.
Apportioned giving supplies the material distribution that lets a recurring sign sustain a community.

structural_cues: 5:112-113 moves from requested descent and eating to settled hearts, knowledge, and witness.
5:114 names the table a recurring feast for first and last, a sign, and provision.
5:115 makes rejection after the disclosed sign more accountable, preserving the link between evidence and response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence food to reassurance to knowledge to witness, then feast to sign to provision. I infer an analogy in which the focus complex distributes those functions across place, time, offerings, and marks; the live alternative is that the table episode is only another sign narrative and should not reshape the focus list as a provisioning table.

changed_reading.before: The House, month, offerings, and garlands are separate supports assembled in one list.
changed_reading.after: Together they can be read as a recurring public table: a coordinated provisioning cycle whose material participation steadies people and teaches through a visible sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope closes by repeating the focus's heavens, earth, every, and thing while adding divine sovereignty and capacity. This exact lexical return scales the reading: the sanctuary order is a local, inspectable instance nested within universal ownership and effective power.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the governing relation under which the focus's local appointment operates.
The repeated upper domain begins the exact cosmic span already used in the focus.
The repeated lower domain completes the same heaven-and-earth field.
Comprehensive totality repeats the focus's refusal of any excluded remainder.
The unrestricted knowable thing repeats the object range of the focus claim.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to enact and sustain the universal order, not knowledge alone.

structural_cues: 5:120 repeats the focus collocation of heavens, earth, every, and thing.
The closing verse changes the predicate from exhaustive knowledge to sovereignty and effective capacity.
5:116-119 has already staged the judgment of human claims before this universal closing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical echo plus sovereignty and capacity. I infer that the focus complex is a finite governance model nested under the order of the whole; the live alternative is that 5:120 is only a closing doxology and the echo does not feed back into qiyaman.

changed_reading.before: The sacred complex is local evidence that God knows the entire cosmos.
changed_reading.after: It is a local order nested within God's ownership and effective governance of the entire cosmos, a model of rule rather than a support that itself bears the universe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant material images in Ka'bah and garlands. It remains anchored in the focus words and gains contextual support from tied obligations and substitute standing; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary structural analogy, never as a lexical replacement for the Ka'bah or qiyaman.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ka'bah as a joint, garlands as twisted binding, and qiyaman as a system in which one element can hold or stand for another.

activation_trace.role: A joint between segments supplies the material analogy of a center that couples otherwise separate routes and obligations.
Twisting one element around another supplies binding as the mobile counterpart to the central joint.
Tying ends together gives the analogy a social and obligational realization in contracted oaths.
Standing in another's place shows the order preserving continuity by coupling roles through substitution.

changed_reading.before: The Ka'bah is the central destination of a protected sacred network.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also the network's social joint: obligations, marked carriers, times, and substitute roles are bound through a center so the whole can keep standing.

strongest_changes: The hunting sequence revises qiyaman from static protection into calibrated boundary, test, and proportionate repair.
The negated appointment of customary animal taboos makes divine authorization constitutive and exposes counterfeit sacred institutions.
The testimony sequence turns the knowledge claim into a two-tier epistemology of revisable human evidence under divine knowledge of the unseen.
The closing heaven-and-earth echo places the local sanctuary order under universal sovereignty and effective capacity.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reactivated the focus's own operators rather than merely adding themes: appointment is negated in counterfeit sacrality, standing becomes procedural substitution, knowledge is tested through witnesses and signs, and the cosmic formula returns under sovereignty. The table sequence additionally joined provision, recurrence, reassurance, and knowledge into a live cross-domain model.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the recurring-table model is a governing contextual mechanism or a strong but local analogy.
How much weight the material joint-and-binding outlier should receive beyond exploratory prose.
Whether qiyaman primarily names livelihood and public order or also carries a stronger governance sense in this context.
